title: Grandma Thinks It's OK To Drive Drunk With Kid In The Car
description:
An officer responded to a report of a vehicle that crashed into a ditch. The caller reported that the driver, later identified as Haley Ferguson, appeared to be intoxicated and a small child was with her. The footage of the initial interaction with Haley wasn’t released because the juvenile could be seen in it. Therefore, we have begun the video from the time that the officer conducts sobriety tests on Haley. Haley was then arrested because of reasonable suspicion of DUI. Haley was charged with OWI (3rd offence), Resisting an officer and misdemeanor bail jumping.
